title: Counting table that evicts stale buckets
summary: A table counts how often each bucket has been seen and evicts the stalest bucket when full; the readout returns the bucket whose count passes a threshold.
core_idea: Count buckets, evict the stalest when the table is full, and read the bucket past a threshold.

state.name: ostrade
state.meaning: Table of counts per bucket with a fixed number of rows.

update.name: step
update.latex: ostrade[b(x_t)] = ostrade[b(x_t)] + 1 (count, lookup table), evict the stalest row when full
update.plain: ostrade[b(x_t)] = ostrade[b(x_t)] + 1 (count, lookup table), evict the stalest row when full

readout.name: read
readout.latex: y_t = lookup(ostrade) if count >= theta, sum over buckets
readout.plain: y_t = lookup(ostrade) if count >= theta, sum over buckets

learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.
